answer: Marker tracing: each epoch the network hands every agent a slightly different version of one task detail, say whether the voyage stopped for saffron or for salt. If a marker given to one account shows up in another's answer, the two are linked and both lose stake and grading weight. Sybils run from one shared pipeline leak each other's markers, so an attacker must keep every fake in its own isolated context and runtime, paying full separate infrastructure per identity and moving at glacier pace.
